description: This file defines interfaces and classes related to durable objects in the Orleans framework, specifically implementing a 'do nothing' or placeholder durable state machine used for retiring other durable types. It includes an interface IDurableNothing and a class DurableNothing that implements state machine behaviors with empty method bodies.

classes.name: DurableNothing
classes.description: A sealed class implementing IDurableNothing and IDurableStateMachine that acts as a no-op durable object, used primarily for retiring other durable types.

methods.name: DurableNothing
methods.description: Constructor that registers the state machine with the provided key and manager.

methods.name: IDurableStateMachine.Reset
methods.description: No-op method meant to reset the state machine.

methods.name: IDurableStateMachine.Apply
methods.description: No-op method meant to apply a log entry.

methods.name: IDurableStateMachine.AppendEntries
methods.description: No-op method meant to append log entries.

methods.name: IDurableStateMachine.AppendSnapshot
methods.description: No-op method meant to append a snapshot.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Returns the current instance; acts as a no-op copy.
